inputs.text: Electricians. Your day is panel upgrades, service calls... and permit paperwork at night. Orchamind is built for how electrical work actually runs. Just say it from the truck. New job: two hundred amp panel upgrade at the Miller house. The AI itemizes the gear, wire, breakers, and labor. Good, better, and best, in seconds. Emergency call? The dispatch board rebalances your crew, so the remodel doesn't slip. Every permit, tracked by stage. Rough-in. Service. Final. Nothing gets covered up before it's signed off. Copper prices move? See margin erosion before it eats your profit. Orchamind. Panel upgrades, service calls, and permits, without the paperwork nights. First month free.
